limits: Coverage conditions deliberately select families; not a failure-rate study.
The single random-full seed was frozen before integration; no fault redraw or flight retry.
The initial nine flights predate admission-only hardening and report-render changes; their saved states were independently rechecked, not relabeled.
The final replay exercises the final admission/CLI boundary and exactly matches the earlier payload trial full run, including its trouble audit.
Record consistency passes do not imply recovery success; surface impacts and time limits are preserved.
All runtime tests use fixed unqualified flight control. No Jev/DeepSeek calls, live hardware or catch claims.
